prior.name: posterior_v2
prior.description: One to three populations (sphere, upright or random cylinder, each with or without a paracrystal), Gaussian sizes by number, LMA; the cut at the effective interface, the Born term at q+ = k_i + k_f, or (both angles known) spheres with the exit-reflected path at q- = k_i - k_f and an effective reflection coefficient r; the bounds of the values are those of posterior/encoding.py (encoding 4)
